description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeCandidateAPI class, which provides API endpoints for purging and listing candidates associated with a vacancy in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for deleting candidates, listing purgeable candidates, and associated validation rules.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for purging and listing candidates related to vacancies, including delete and fetch functionalities with validation rules.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the PurgeService instance used for candidate data purging.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to purge candidate data for a specific vacancy.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring the vacancy ID exists and is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list purgeable candidates for a specific vacancy with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the listing operation, ensuring the vacancy ID exists.
